title: Supreme Court: Clark v. Sweeney
summary: The Fourth Circuit departed from the principle of party presentation and abused its discretion in granting a new trial. (No. 25-52, opinion by the Court (per curiam); 607 U.S. 7).

title: Supreme Court: Pitts v. Mississippi
summary: A defendant’s Sixth Amendment right to meet his accusers face to face may not be denied without case-specific findings of necessity, notwithstanding Mississippi’s right-to-screening statute, Miss. Code Ann. §99–43–101(2)(g). (No. 24-1159, opinion by the Court (per curiam); 607 U.S. 1).
